scope: Same-cell multi-paragraph research-content insertion; source/test review plus supplemental independent VM probes

findings_resolved.issue: Rich heading/list insertion into covariant List<WmlParagraph> cell owner threw a runtime iterable TypeError
findings_resolved.resolution: Insert each supported block individually; fresh probes and product tests exercise success and preservation

findings_resolved.issue: Initially invalid cross-cell raw-session range could become eligible after endpoint reparenting that preserved flat paragraph order
findings_resolved.resolution: Constructor owner capture now requires both ordered endpoints and consecutive ordinary initial blocks

reviewed_guards: Exact initial section/note and nested table-row-cell-list ownership chain is captured and rechecked
Selected paragraph aliases across stories/containers are refused
Vertical continuations, structural controls/frames, cross-cell boundaries and incoming tables stay guarded
Existing field protection, plain-text boundaries and note ownership remain in the original path
Controller rollback/undo snapshots retain owners and reject stale revisions, selection and lifecycle changes
coverage_review: Body, footnote and endnote engine targets
Nested and merged-origin cells with persistent ownership metadata
Simple and complex prefix/suffix active citation packets and refreshed display lengths
Forward/reverse controller selections, undo/redo and DOCX reopen
Direct Add Note/Add Annotation dialog completion and cancellation
Shared cell/list/table aliases, owner replacement without revision, cross-cell/row boundaries, continuation cells, control/frame ancestors and selected table bands
limits: No live Zotero/Word/LibreOffice plugin session is qualified by these probes
Notes-pane table-cell editing is not supplied by this engine increment
Owner identities/list containers are pinned; unchanged-owner geometry changes outside the controller revision contract are not exhaustively snapshotted
Independent probes are separate from the product regression suite count
